en.role: Chairman of the Management Board of Rusnano
en.quote: There is no issue of ruble devaluation; it does not exist.
en.head: The ruble depreciated sharply by year’s end.
en.body: The official dollar rate was 33.87 rubles on January 22, 2014. During the December currency crisis, the dollar traded above 60 rubles on the Moscow Exchange. The comparison shows a later devaluation, although Chubais was assessing the issue at the time, not promising a particular exchange rate.
